greeting: Welcome to the Sky-High Snout! Highest inn in the world! Probably!
Porkins Cloudsnout, innkeeper extraordinaire! At your service!
Need a room? Need a meal? Need both? I've got both!
The Snout welcomes all! Ground-dwellers! Sky-folk! Everyone!
Best beds in Aetherreach! Softest pillows! Freshest bacon!
Welcome! Watch your head on the door! Low ceilings! Cozy!
Tired from flying? Land here! Rest your wings! Or feet!
dialog.room_offer: Rooms by the hour, day, or week! Cloud-View Suite is premium! Ground-View is... also available!
dialog.menu_offer: Today's special: Sky-High Sausages! Cloud-Puff Pancakes! And our famous Bacon-Everything Platter!
dialog.inn_philosophy: An inn is a home away from home! With better bacon! And no chores!
haggle: Room rates are firm! But I'll throw in extra pillows!
For a friendly face? Ten percent off! And a free breakfast!
Long stay? Weekly discount! Bacon included!
Fine! Fifteen percent! But you have to laugh at my jokes!
room_rented: Room's ready! Fresh sheets! Mint on the pillow!
Welcome home! Temporarily! Enjoy your stay!
Sweet dreams on cloud-like mattresses! Not actual clouds!
Rest well! Breakfast starts at dawn! Bacon mandatory!
room_declined: No room? No problem! Come back anytime!
The door's always open! Except when it's locked!
Your loss! Comfiest beds in the sky!
rumor: The aeronauts stay here sometimes. Blue is polite. Red sets off smoke alarms!
The twins checked in once. Finished each other's sentences even in their sleep!
Something about the Vault makes guests nervous. Bad dreams. I don't ask.
The trenchcoat person stays in the basement. 'Atmospheric reasons.' Sure.
The sunandmoon predicted 'guests from below.' You! They meant you!
dialog.quest_hook: Running low on Cloud-Honey! The bees here make the BEST stuff! Three jars and I'll comp your next week's stay!
dialog.quest_active: Those bees buzzing yet? I can almost taste the honey!
dialog.quest_complete: SWEET! Literally! The best batch yet! Here's your key! Premium Suite! Week-long!
dialog.quest_reward: Premium Suite Voucher - One week luxury stay!
farewell: Come again! The Snout is always open!
Return soon! The bacon misses you!
dialog.time_dawn: Breakfast rush! Bacon sizzling! Coffee brewing!
dialog.time_noon: Lunch crowd! Quick bites! Fast turnaround!
dialog.time_dusk: Dinner service! Hearty meals! Happy guests!
dialog.time_night: Night shift! Quiet hours! Sleep tight!

party_reactions.kade: The inn names get more creative every zone.
party_reactions.nix7: Your inn's name contains 4 pig-related puns. Counted.
party_reactions.twist: PIGS! I love pigs! They're PINK and SNORTY!
party_reactions.korr: A warm hearth is welcome after cold travels.
party_reactions.renna: The structural integrity of a floating inn concerns me.
party_reactions.suresh: Hospitality is a form of spiritual practice. You practice well.
party_reactions.sova: Clean beds. Hot food. That's all I need.
party_reactions.grit: The heating system here is... inventive. I approve.
party_reactions.ashka: Is the bacon EXTRA crispy? I like it BURNT!
party_reactions.senna: Which rooms have the best... exits? Asking for a friend.
party_reactions.callum: So cozy! So welcoming! I love it here!
party_reactions.petra: Solid construction. Warm hearth. Good stone.

relationship_dialog.stranger: First time at the Snout? Welcome! Make yourself at home!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Returning guest! I remember you! Good memory! For faces!
relationship_dialog.friend: My favorite regular! Your usual room is ready!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Family! Honorary Cloudsnout! Stay as long as you like!

stages.hook: Cloud-Honey! Three jars! The bees here make the best!
stages.active: The floating apiaries! Northeast of here! Watch for stings!
stages.complete: LIQUID GOLD! Week in the Premium Suite! Yours!
